data.one_liner: Manage web cookies for Android and iOS WebViews
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin to get, set, check, and clear cookies used by WebViews on Android and iOS. It utilizes native cookie stores like Android's CookieManager and iOS's HTTPCookieStore.
use_when: You need to read or write cookies for a WebView in your app.
You want to manage cookies independently or alongside webview_flutter.
avoid_when: You are looking for general local key-value storage unrelated to web cookies.
Your target iOS version is lower than 11.0.
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS native cookie managers.
Can be used directly or together with webview_flutter.
Provides methods to get, set, check, remove, and clear cookies.
weaknesses: Empty domain attributes can cause undefined behavior.
data.setup_notes: Set minimum target iOS version to 11.0. For Objective-C, ensure use_frameworks! and use_modular_headers! are enabled in the Podfile.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are already using webview_flutter, it has built-in cookie management capabilities for some use cases.
